notes.title: "LingTian 2" Demo Released
notes.content:
[p]Dear Princess, Your prince "LingTian 2" demo has now been released and is also available to try within the 1000 Princes game. There are slight differences between the two: The standalone "LingTian 2" demo contains the full content of Chapters 1–3, along with music, chat, diary, interviews, and archives. Meanwhile, the in-game trial version of "LingTian 2" in 1000 Princes includes only selected portions from Chapters 1–3.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/483381b9c6ba57bed9556af6b2cbe365e369c702.png"][/img][/p][p]"LingTian 2" is a sweet and romantic visual novel otome game for women. As an ordinary girl from the Kingdom of Fang, your connection with Prince LingTian begins with your kind heart. Now, your love story is about to begin — embrace this magnificent royal romance! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/0fdc0595479bf7edb9a3450cb2dd93dd0c762e3c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/5b079f2b5f371c867bd8a7fc3a375f0cff43097c.png"][/img][/p][p]▌Romance[/p][p]The royal family of the Kingdom of Fang holds a “Love Seeking Campaign” to help Prince LingTian find his future bride, aiming to divert public attention and ease social tensions. After the royal examination, you and several other girls advance to the final round. However, the moment you step into the palace, the Prince shows you special care and attentively protects you.[/p][p]Inside the palace, girls must search for hidden “Fang Cards” to earn opportunities for dates with the Prince. Yet, Prince LingTian secretly helps you cheat, offering clues only to you, allowing you to monopolize his time.[/p][p]Even when you mistakenly bite the Prince, he wholeheartedly defends you without any blame. When you're restrained by soldiers, the Prince ignores his own injuries and scolds them harshly, forbidding them from hurting you.[/p][p]On a snowy day, the Prince personally welcomes the girls into the palace and gifts them phones as a welcome gift. Soon after, the other girls realize their phones can't contact the Prince at all — only you can call and message him. When you ask him why, he answers tenderly: "Because I only like you. I have no interest in the others. I only care about you, only focus on you, and only want to be with you." [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3569480"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]About the 1000 Princes Series[/b] [/p][p]The "1000 Princes" series is currently undergoing a complete revamp. Moving forward, the focus will be on learning Chinese, including:  
1. Chinese learning tutorial videos with the 1000 Princes  
2. Shorts: Learn Chinese characters with the 1000 Princes  
3. Chinese learning e-book series with the 1000 Princes  
4. Learn Chinese while playing the 1000 Princes Chinese otome games  
5. Learn Chinese through songs by the 1000 Princes[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/8e8555c0c9af0cf2b126769a832ca34fbf94a8d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/669ac5b94f07eb0f6e5ec9786d2a86bc0b9d8d61.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/ef74fc8838e1af24224b2269dfe18a6d6e4cc6a6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Chinese is the most profound and mysterious language in the world. Each character contains a unique mystical energy, and is associated with one of the five elements: metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. You can observe how different characters align with people, places, time, and events. Each character even holds divinatory power to predict fortune or misfortune. Chinese characters are rare, powerful, and imbued with universal energy and hidden messages. Start learning Chinese with the 1000 Princes today![/p][p][/p]
[quote] Please watch the following Chinese learning video. Chinese, Pinyin, and English subtitles are fixed at the top, and you can also choose to display CC subtitles in 13 different languages below.[/quote]

notes.title: LingTian 2 demo version is set to launch later this month
notes.content:
[p]My dearest, I am your prince LingTian. The weather has become hot lately, so I specially prepared some refreshing watermelon for you. Let’s enjoy it together when we meet! I urged the developers “Four Ducks” to hurry up with the completion of *LingTian 2*. Today, I received an email from them, and I want to share the development progress of *LingTian 2* with you.[/p]
[p]1. The game script of *LingTian 2* is complete, and the scripts for Chapters 1–3 have already been converted into code.[/p]
[p]2. The story illustrations for Chapters 1–3 are completed.[/p]
[p]3. The blue UI is finished.[/p]
[p]The demo version of *LingTian 2* is expected to launch at the end of this month (July 2025) on STEAM and Google Play.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/b64b928a974469546763af69b19729ad14674927.jpg"][/img][/p]
[p]Game planner Yabo shared more development details with me. In *LingTian 2*, 22 other finalists will appear. But I have no interest in them at all. I told them even if those girls are made with low-poly models, it’s fine—after all, to me, they are just background characters. I only care about you. But the game artist Yagu insisted on delivering high-quality visuals, so all 22 girls were modeled in detail, even though they are only supporting roles.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/440c929f9cd8a3440c9b2894e3261e3603d723e6.png"][/img][/p]
[p]This time, the game UI and cover art share the same tone: icy blue. Although it's the height of summer in real life, the world of *LingTian 2* is still a wintry snowland. That’s why we used snowy blue. The beautifully styled blue icons and the motif of an open blue book all follow the same color scheme and luxurious aesthetic.[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/09dc8576986773f988ccbe529ba6f3539ff9dc9e.png"][/img][/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/d554efb4ea603d62e6fa46693483a52766eb5919.png"][/img][/p]
[p]Regarding my character model, I gave Four Ducks one of my light brown cotton jackets. They first took photos of the jacket and then used AI modeling to generate its 3D version. After that, they dressed my 3D model in it. However, the chest area was see-through and looked odd, so they paired it with a high-neck sweater underneath.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/6f882fe8a11330984752230db3b41a390082010b.png"][/img][/p]
[p]This outfit not only appears on the cover of *LingTian 2*, but also in the music video “My Embrace Is Your Harbor.” Let’s listen to the song and eat watermelon together when the time comes![/p]
[p][/p]
[previewyoutube="OqYJpS3jZtU;full"][/previewyoutube]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/ff6cdd4f5e46685b68c15d5ed08670f55332c27c.png"][/img][/p]
[p]Oh, and by the way, this song and MV are included on the “1000PRINCES 王子” YouTube channel. This channel features music from the “1000PRINCES” game series, and it has now been upgraded to an Official Artist Channel. YouTube marks such channels with a ♪ music note icon, so you can now see the ♪ symbol next to the channel name “1000PRINCES 王子”.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528094/536e5655251174af2cfce737f4d67cfab697abb3.gif"][/img][/p]
[p]Please remember to stay cool and protect yourself from the sun this summer. Look forward to our very own *LingTian 2* demo! I miss you! Love you![/p]
